response.goal: Two-way sync of contacts between HubSpot and our PostgreSQL users table so new signups appear in HubSpot within 5 minutes, edits to lifecycle stage in HubSpot write back to PostgreSQL, recent updates win conflicts with logging, and it runs on our server with a short README.

plan.step: Kickoff and requirement alignment on database schema and HubSpot properties
Develop the two-way sync script in Python or Node to handle new signups and lifecycle stage updates
Implement conflict resolution logic where the most recent update wins and log every conflict
Deploy the service on the client server and write the maintenance README

milestones.name: Milestone 1: Core Sync Logic
milestones.deliverable: Working sync script handling new signups and HubSpot lifecycle stage changes with conflict resolution

milestones.name: Milestone 2: Deployment and Documentation
milestones.deliverable: Script running on the client server with a complete maintenance README

proof_map.step: Kickoff and requirement alignment on database schema and HubSpot properties
Develop the two-way sync script in Python or Node to handle new signups and lifecycle stage updates
Implement conflict resolution logic where the most recent update wins and log every conflict
Deploy the service on the client server and write the maintenance README

risks.risk: API rate limits from HubSpot during high traffic or initial full sync
risks.mitigation: Implement batching, exponential backoff, and rate-limit handling in the sync script

risks.risk: Clock drift or timestamp discrepancies between PostgreSQL and HubSpot
risks.mitigation: Use UTC timestamps consistently across both systems for the last-modified comparison

questions: What hosting environment or server OS will the script be deployed on?
Are there any specific Python or Node libraries your team prefers for database and API connections?
assumptions: The fixed price budget of $800 is sufficient for the scope outlined
The client will provide necessary API keys and database access for development and testing
